svg.title: Odylith benchmark family heatmap
svg.text: Live Benchmark Family Heatmap: measured family deltas
These are published median family deltas from the Live Benchmark for Odylith on versus odylith_off (raw host CLI). Families
are ordered by Odylith's developer-first benchmark archetypes rather than token cost. Green marks declared-metric improvement
for this operating-policy view. Live session input deltas are shown as compact token deltas and time to
valid outcome deltas are shown as humanized durations; lower values are better for both. Recall and validation favor higher
Green: Odylith better | Red: baseline better | Ordered by developer archetype
